test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under the PM E-DRIVE Scheme, which of the following vehicle categories are NOT eligible for demand incentives?

options.text: Electric three-wheelers used for personal use
. Electric trucks with valid scrapping certificates

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Electric three-wheelers used for personal use**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **PM E-DRIVE Scheme** is a government initiative aimed at promoting the adoption of **electric vehicles (EVs)** in India.
 
• Under this scheme, **incentives** are provided to reduce the cost of eligible electric vehicles to encourage their use and reduce carbon emissions.
 
• **Electric three-wheelers used for personal use** are **not eligible** for demand incentives under the scheme.</li&
